crossRefs.note: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice…

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.
translations.bsb: And Saul waited seven days for the time appointed by Samuel, but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and the troops began to desert Saul.
translations.kjv: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
translations.asv: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
